entities.summary: Radoslav Rosenov is a Bulgarian boxer. He competed at the 2024 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the silver medal in the lightweight event. He also competed at the 2025 World Boxing Championships, winning the bronze medal in the men's 60 kg event.
